items.q: What should you remember about **Project Glass Wing replay**?
items.a: **Mythos released broadly → pulled** back after government pressure → now critical-infrastructure-only again; same record spinning.

items.q: What should you remember about **GPT 5.6 also gated**?
items.a: **OpenAI limited preview to** "trusted partners" at US government request; frontier labs uniformly slowed.

items.q: What should you remember about **Harness vs raw model**?
items.a: **much of coding-agent gains are harness/tooling, not weights** alone; GLM 5.2 without harness still beats harnessed Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.5 on IDOR security benchmark.

items.q: What should you remember about **IDOR = HackerOne #4**?
items.a: **insecure direct object reference (pass arbitrary** user ID → leak data) is a top real-world vuln class Sam Gre benchmarked.

items.q: What should you remember about **Open-weight threat economics**?
items.a: **Hugging Face download + cloud** GPU rental (~$73/hr) makes offensive capability affordable; scams can exceed hourly cost.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mixture-of-agents beats Mythos**?
items.a: **Hermes (GPT 5.5 + Opus** 4.8) and Microsoft multi-agent approaches score higher on same security benchmarks.

items.q: What should you remember about **Safety argument inverted**?
items.a: **gating makes world *less* safe**: offensive teams get in anyway (insider leaks, equally capable open models); defenders lag.

items.q: What should you remember about **Federation > gatekeeping**?
items.a: **if models truly help secure software,** everyone should patch in lockstep; selective access lets funded attackers exploit lagging maintainers.

items.q: What should you remember about **Dario's real goal (per Primeagen)**?
items.a: **monitor/control inputs → control outputs; regulation** dream realized but doesn't stop open-weight scaling Dario warned about in 2023 clips.

items.q: What should you remember about **Michael Arnaldi policy**?
items.a: **free usage for core** infrastructure maintainers; unrestricted strongest models; restriction guarantees offensive advantage.
